build.optimization: MSVC Release default /O2. HyperCine CMake does not force /arch:AVX2.
build.threaded_encoder: _THREADED_ENCODER=0. CFHDCodecThreaded is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL and does not build.

hardware.gpu_list: GPU 0: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Laptop GPU (UUID: GPU-58f47607-25ba-4199-bba3-6c42c8fd3633)
hardware.gpu_query: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Laptop GPU, 610.62, 16376 MiB, [N/A], 3105 MHz, 9001 MHz, 1, 8, 4, 16

software.graph_mode: enabled for headline GPU runs; compared against disabled in graph suite
software.benchmark_order: resolutions=1080,4k,8k; per-trial GPU mode rotation across 3 permutations
software.sequence_definition: 1080p: 1000 measured frames (96-frame distinct cycle); 4K_UHD: 300 measured frames (36-frame distinct cycle); 8K_UHD: 120 measured frames (12-frame distinct cycle); warmup >= slot_count excluded from wall clock; pipeline fully drained and cudaDeviceSynchronize completed before timer stop

cpu_baseline_note: Baseline 1 is pristine CFHD_EncodeSample with _THREADED_ENCODER=0 and one encode thread. Baseline 2, the HyperCine CPU reference inside VerifyPhase3ASequence120, is an equivalence oracle using the upstream spatial wavelet and CPU entropy. It is not a second throughput product, so speedups use Baseline 1 only.
device_input_note: DeviceInput measures GPU-resident integration throughput when BGRA frames are already in device memory; it must never be presented as conventional file-transcode performance.

sequence.definition: ProductionEndToEnd completed-frame throughput. Wall clock starts when the first measured frame is accepted after warmup and stops after that frame's compressed sample is assembled and cudaDeviceSynchronize has drained every stream. Warmup covers one-time CUDA graph capture when it is at least the slot count. Pageable staging is inside the window for HostPageableEndToEnd. Encoder creation, input generation, and filesystem output are outside. This is not a submission rate. With multiple slots, 1000/mean_latency is not the throughput.
